description: This Java class provides centralized handling of exceptions within a Spring Boot REST API. It maps exceptions to HTTP responses with appropriate status codes and structured error payloads, supporting validation, not-found, conflict, and generic errors.
external_methods: build(HttpStatus, String, String, HttpServletRequest, Map<String, String>)

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller advice class that intercepts exceptions thrown within the API layer and converts them into structured API error responses with appropriate HTTP status codes.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a ResponseEntity containing an ApiError object with the specified status, code, message, request URI, and optional details map.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles ResourceNotFoundException, returning a 404 Not Found response with relevant error details.

methods.name: handleConflict
methods.description: Handles ResourceConflictException, returning a 409 Conflict response with details about the conflict.

methods.name: handleBodyValidation
methods.description: Handles validation errors from request bodies, returning a 400 Bad Request response with details of field errors.

methods.name: handleConstraintViolations
methods.description: Handles validation constraint violations, returning a 400 Bad Request response.

methods.name: handleDataIntegrity
methods.description: Handles database integrity violations, returning a 409 Conflict response to indicate data conflicts.

methods.name: handleUnknown
methods.description: Fallback for unexpected exceptions, returning a 500 Internal Server Error.
